MeasuredCNFSubset:
∃ test : List Bool × List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair Computability.encodeBool test ∧
      ∀ (φ U : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF U) = true ↔
        {c : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ d ∈ φ, d.toFinset = c} ⊆
        {c : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ d ∈ U, d.toFinset = c}
MeasuredEliminationWalk:
let pair := fun (p q : List Bool) => List.replicate p.length true ++ false :: (p ++ q)
    let clauses := fun (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) =>
      {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d}
    let eliminate := fun (G : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ)) (x : ℕ) =>
      {C | (C ∈ G ∧ (x,true) ∉ C ∧ (x,false) ∉ C) ∨
        ∃ P ∈ G, ∃ N ∈ G, (x,true) ∈ P ∧ (x,false) ∉ P ∧
          (x,false) ∈ N ∧ (x,true) ∉ N ∧ C = P.erase (x,true) ∪ N.erase (x,false)}
    ∃ run : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) run ∧
      ∀ (φ U : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (order : List ℕ),
        let result := run (pair (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause (order.map (fun x => (x,true))))
          (pair (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF U)))
        (result ≠ [] ↔ ∀ j ≤ order.length, (order.take j).foldl eliminate (clauses φ) ⊆ clauses U) ∧
        (result ≠ [] → ∃ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, result = true :: PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∧
          clauses ψ = order.foldl eliminate (clauses φ))
MeasuredVariableOrderCode:
∃ normalize : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) normalize ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, normalize (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) =
        PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause ((φ.flatten).map (fun l => (l.1,true)))
FullEliminationSAT:
∀ (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ)) (order : List ℕ),
    let eliminate := fun (G : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ)) (x : ℕ) =>
      {C | (C ∈ G ∧ (x,true) ∉ C ∧ (x,false) ∉ C) ∨
        ∃ P ∈ G, ∃ N ∈ G, (x,true) ∈ P ∧ (x,false) ∉ P ∧
          (x,false) ∈ N ∧ (x,true) ∉ N ∧ C = P.erase (x,true) ∪ N.erase (x,false)}
    (∀ c ∈ F, ∀ l ∈ c, l.1 ∈ order) →
      (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable F ↔ order.foldl eliminate F = ∅)
EliminationStageWidth:
∀ (k : ℕ) (φ U : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (order : List ℕ),
    let clauses := fun (formula : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) =>
      {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ formula, c.toFinset = d}
    let eliminate := fun (G : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ)) (x : ℕ) =>
      {C | (C ∈ G ∧ (x,true) ∉ C ∧ (x,false) ∉ C) ∨
        ∃ P ∈ G, ∃ N ∈ G, (x,true) ∈ P ∧ (x,false) ∉ P ∧
          (x,false) ∈ N ∧ (x,true) ∉ N ∧ C = P.erase (x,true) ∪ N.erase (x,false)}
    (∀ c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause, c ∈ U ↔ c.length ≤ k ∧ c ⊆ φ.flatten) →
    ((∀ d ∈ order.foldl eliminate (clauses φ), Finset.card d ≤ k) ↔
    order.foldl eliminate (clauses φ) ⊆ clauses U)

    let clauses := fun (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) =>

    {s : List Bool | ∃ φ U O : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,

MeasuredWidthElimination:
∀ (k : ℕ),
    let clauses := fun (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) =>
      {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d}
    let eliminate := fun (G : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ)) (x : ℕ) =>
      {C | (C ∈ G ∧ (x,true) ∉ C ∧ (x,false) ∉ C) ∨
        ∃ P ∈ G, ∃ N ∈ G, (x,true) ∈ P ∧ (x,false) ∉ P ∧
          (x,false) ∈ N ∧ (x,true) ∉ N ∧ C = P.erase (x,true) ∪ N.erase (x,false)}
    ∃ run : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) run ∧
      ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (order : List ℕ),
        let bounded := ∀ j ≤ order.length, ∀ c ∈ (order.take j).foldl eliminate (clauses φ), Finset.card c ≤ k
        let result := run (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause (order.map (fun x => (x,true))),PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ)
        (result ≠ [] ↔ bounded) ∧
        (bounded → (∀ c ∈ clauses φ, ∀ l ∈ c, l.1 ∈ order) →
          (result = [true] ↔ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable (clauses φ)))
DavisPutnamElimination:
∀ (x : ℕ) (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ)),
    PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable
      {C | (C ∈ F ∧ (x,true) ∉ C ∧ (x,false) ∉ C) ∨
        ∃ P ∈ F, ∃ N ∈ F, (x,true) ∈ P ∧ (x,false) ∉ P ∧
          (x,false) ∈ N ∧ (x,true) ∉ N ∧ C = P.erase (x,true) ∪ N.erase (x,false)}
    ↔ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable F
EliminationOrderRefutation:
∀ (F U : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ)) (order : List ℕ),
    let eliminate := fun (G : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ)) (x : ℕ) =>
      {C | (C ∈ G ∧ (x,true) ∉ C ∧ (x,false) ∉ C) ∨
        ∃ P ∈ G, ∃ N ∈ G, (x,true) ∈ P ∧ (x,false) ∉ P ∧
          (x,false) ∈ N ∧ (x,true) ∉ N ∧ C = P.erase (x,true) ∪ N.erase (x,false)}
    (∀ c ∈ F, ∀ l ∈ c, l.1 ∈ order) →
    (∀ i ≤ order.length, (order.take i).foldl eliminate F ⊆ U) →
    ¬ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable F →
    ∃ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation F π ∧ ∀ c ∈ π, c ∈ U
MeasuredPivotClauseFilter:
∀ (p n : Bool),
    ∃ pick : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) pick ∧
      ∀ (x : ℕ) (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), pick (PEqualNP.Search.encodeLiteral (x,true),PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) =
        PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.filter (fun c => decide (decide ((x,true) ∈ c) = p ∧ decide ((x,false) ∈ c) = n)))
MeasuredDavisPutnamStep:
∃ eliminate : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) eliminate ∧
      ∀ (x : ℕ) (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), ∃ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, eliminate (PEqualNP.Search.encodeLiteral (x,true),PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∧
        {c : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ d ∈ ψ, d.toFinset = c} =
        {C : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ |
          ((∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = C) ∧ (x,true) ∉ C ∧ (x,false) ∉ C) ∨
          ∃ P, (∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = P) ∧ ∃ N, (∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = N) ∧
            (x,true) ∈ P ∧ (x,false) ∉ P ∧ (x,false) ∈ N ∧ (x,true) ∉ N ∧
            C = P.erase (x,true) ∪ N.erase (x,false)}
MeasuredCNFIntersection:
∃ intersect : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) intersect ∧
      ∀ (φ U : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), intersect (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF U) =
        PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (U.filter (fun c => decide (∃ d ∈ φ, d.toFinset = c.toFinset)))
MeasuredBoundedClauseUniverse:
∀ (k : ℕ),
    ∃ generate : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) generate ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, ∃ U : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, generate (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF U ∧
        ∀ c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause, c ∈ U ↔ c.length ≤ k ∧ c ⊆ φ.flatMap id
